headers:
Item 19 is 207,000 SF, but the L001 note
says approximately 6.78 acres (295,336
SF) will be disturbed and the site data
table shows 239,194 SF of landscape area
by itself. Does the 207,000 SF cover only
areas of proposed grade change, or the
full limit of work?

The 207,000 SF represents areas where grading will
be affected. Areas where existing grades are to
remain, especially beneath existing tree driplines,
are not included in this quantity.
The 239,194 SF shown in the site data table
represents lawn and planting areas only, not the total
disturbed area.
sample:
Is on-site placement of excess material
allowed? If not, and an off-site spoil site
gets used, L001 note 7 treats that site as
part of the project site for erosion control.

Yes. On-site placement of excess material is
permitted. The location, handling, placement, and
disposal of excess material are the Contractor’s
means and methods. The Contractor is responsible for
providing and maintaining all required tree protection
and erosion control measures associated with the
work, including measures applicable to any off-site
spoil area used by the Contractor as per Note 7.

Proposed grades run past the limit of
work and the property line in places. Is
offsite grading intended, and if so who
holds the easement or the owner's
permission?

Grade to back of curb when shown outside of L.O.W.
Line
